GrowthWorx / Services finance

From timesheet to invoice to payroll, in one flow.

Finance operations for IT services firms that bill some clients by the resource and others by the project. Month-end stops being a reconciliation exercise.

Invoices raised straight from timesheets, so cash comes in sooner.

Request a walkthrough →More in GrowthWorx →

What gets in the way today

Three tools, one number

Timesheets, invoices and payroll live in different tools, so finance rebuilds the same numbers every month.

Two billing models

Resource billing and project billing follow different rules and rarely reconcile cleanly.

Late timesheets, late cash

Missing submissions delay invoices and collections.

Services finance, end to end

Capability areaFeatures
BillingTimesheet sync and automatic invoices · Resource and project billing side by side · Credit notes and reconciliation
CommercialsPurchase orders · Client management · Payment tracking
PeoplePayroll dispatch · Employee and consultant records · Skill matrix across the bench
OperationsReminders for missing submissions · Personal to-do lists · Role-based access for finance and sales

Who it's for and how to get it

Who it's for: IT services firms, systems integrators and consultancies of roughly 50 to 500 people.

How to get it: Subscription per firm, priced by billable headcount.
